summary: Equitable mortgage by deposit of title deeds; actionable debt; prior mortgage deeds and promissory notes; failure to register sale deed; interest stipulation; vakalatnama scope; unauthorized representation; delay condonation in appeal; ex-parte decree; reliance on panchayat agreement; preliminary mortgage decree.
final_judgment: Appeals allowed; High Court orders set aside; restoration of intra-court appeal for fresh hearing; preliminary mortgage decree upheld.
